<<Notes on Cleaning A Telescope Mirror>>  
Cleaning a telescope mirror requires care to ensure clear views of the night sky. First, I removed the old coating using a soft cloth and mild detergent. Next, I used a soft brush to scrub away any residue. The mirror looked clean, but I noticed a faint flue mark—likely from previous use. I carefully removed it with a fine abrasive. Finally, I applied a thin layer of tallow-based lubricant to prevent future dirt buildup. The mirror now shines brightly, ready for the next observation.
